```{r load libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(biomaRt)
library(viridisLite)
library(edgeR)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(pheatmap)
library(PNWColors)
```

```{r TSS - LTR intersection}
# load bedtools intersect results for TSS window (20bp) and repbase ltrs 
tss_only_int<- read.table("FLAIR_TSS_tx_repbase_int.gtf", sep ="\t")
repbase_ltrs<- read.table("repbase_LTRs.gtf", sep ="\t") %>% mutate(ltr = str_extract(V9, "-.*; t"))
repbase_ltrs$ltr<- gsub("-", "", repbase_ltrs$ltr)
repbase_ltrs$ltr<- gsub("; t", "", repbase_ltrs$ltr)
repbase_sum<- repbase_ltrs %>% group_by(ltr) %>% summarize(total=n()) %>% arrange(desc(total))

tss_only_int <- tss_only_int %>% mutate(ltr = str_extract(V15, "-.*; t"))

tss_only_int$ltr<- gsub("-", "", tss_only_int$ltr)
tss_only_int$ltr<- gsub("; t", "", tss_only_int$ltr)

# group by ltr, plot normalized

tss_only_int_sum<- tss_only_int %>% group_by(ltr) %>% summarize(n=n()) %>% arrange(desc(n))

tss_only_int_sum<- left_join(tss_only_int_sum, repbase_sum)

tss_only_int_sum<- tss_only_int_sum %>% mutate(norm = n/total) %>% arrange(desc(norm))


pal <- pnw_palette("Lake",20)

tss_only_int_sum %>% head(n =15) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(ltr, desc(norm)), y =norm, fill = ltr, label = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("") +
  theme(legend.position = "null", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,  vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  ylab("# transcripts with HERV TSS (norm)") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  ggtitle("norm by family size")


#### by LTR
## unique LTRs / total ltrs in that family

tss_only_int_ltr<- tss_only_int %>% group_by(ltr) %>% summarize(unique_ltrs = length(unique(V8))) %>% arrange(desc(unique_ltrs))

tss_only_int_ltr<- left_join(tss_only_int_ltr, repbase_sum) %>% mutate(norm = unique_ltrs / total) %>% arrange(desc(norm), desc(unique_ltrs))

pal <- pnw_palette("Starfish",15)

tss_only_int_ltr %>% head(n =15) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(ltr, desc(norm)), y =norm, fill = ltr, label = unique_ltrs)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  xlab("") +
  theme(legend.position = "null", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,  vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  ylab("Enrichment per LTR type") +
  geom_text(aes(label = unique_ltrs), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  ggtitle("")

```

```{r LTR - gene}
tss_only_int <- tss_only_int %>% 
  mutate(idx = str_extract(V15, "B\\d+")) %>% 
  mutate(gene = str_extract(V4, "ENSG\\d+")) # strip version

ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes",mirror = "useast",  dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
gene_info <- getBM(mart = ensembl, values = tss_only_int$gene, 
                    filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                    attributes = c("ensembl_transcript_id_version",
                                   "external_gene_name",
                                   "ensembl_gene_id_version",
                                   "ensembl_gene_id",
                                   "entrezgene_id", 
                                   "transcript_start",
                                   "transcript_end",
                                   "transcription_start_site"))

counts <- read.table("flair_quant.counts.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T)
tss_counts <- data.frame(counts) %>% 
  filter(ids %in% tss_only_int$V4) %>% 
  select(c(ids, K130N1_healthy_batch1, K130T4_tumor_batch1, K97N2_healthy_batch1, K97T3_tumor_batch1))

row.names(tss_counts) <- tss_counts$ids
tss_counts <- as.matrix(tss_counts[, -1])

annotation <- data.frame(id = colnames(tss_counts),
                          condition = c("normal", "tumor", "normal", "tumor"))
row.names(annotation) <- annotation$id

# normalize
cpm <- cpm(tss_counts) %>% as.data.frame()

tumor_samples <- c("K130T4_tumor_batch1", "K97T3_tumor_batch1")
normal_samples <- c("K130N1_healthy_batch1", "K97N2_healthy_batch1")

# calculate lfc
lfc <- cpm %>%
  mutate(
    tumor_mean = rowMeans(across(all_of(tumor_samples))),
    normal_mean = rowMeans(across(all_of(normal_samples))),
    log2FC = log2((normal_mean + 1) / (tumor_mean + 1))
  ) %>%
  select(log2FC)

lfc_subset <- lfc %>%
  filter(abs(log2FC) >= 2)

min(lfc_subset$log2FC)
max(lfc_subset$log2FC)

# plot 
mat <- lfc_subset %>% as.matrix()

pheatmap(mat,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = F,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  breaks = seq(-10, 10, length.out = 101),
  main = "Log2 Fold Change (Tumor vs Normal)",
  angle_col = 0
)

### add gene classification
lfc_subset <- lfc_subset %>% rownames_to_column("V4")

# join on V4 to bring in the gene (ENSG) column from tss_only_int
lfc_tss <- left_join(lfc_subset, tss_only_int, by = "V4")

gene_info_key <- left_join(lfc_tss, gene_info, by = c("gene" = "ensembl_gene_id")) %>%
  select(gene, V4, log2FC, external_gene_name, ensembl_gene_id_version) %>%
  distinct()

gene_info_key$external_gene_name[which(gene_info_key$external_gene_name == "")] <- NA
gene_info_key <- gene_info_key %>% mutate(gene_final = coalesce(external_gene_name, gene))

# assign the rest of the NAs to novel or HERV
gene_info_key <- gene_info_key %>% 
  mutate(gene_name = ifelse(is.na(gene_final) == TRUE, V4, gene_final)) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(gene_name, "RBRT"))
gene_info_key$gene_name <- make.unique(gene_info_key$gene_name)

gene_info_mat <- gene_info_key %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_name") %>% 
  select(log2FC) %>% 
  arrange(desc(log2FC))

#### filter annotated HERV
gene_info_mat <- gene_info_mat %>% filter(!row.names(.) == "ERVE-1")

## top/bottom 10 by log2FC
gene_info_mat_sub <- rbind(head(gene_info_mat, n = 10), tail(gene_info_mat, n = 10))

pheatmap(gene_info_mat_sub,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = T,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  breaks = seq(-15, 15, length.out = 100),
  main = "Log2 Fold Change (Tumor vs Normal)",
  angle_col = 0
)

```


```{r plot TSS position}
flairbed <- read.table("flair_combined.bed", sep = "\t")
colnames(tss_only_int)[2:3] <- c("tss_start", "tss_end")

df_plot <- tss_only_int %>%
  left_join(flairbed, by = "V4") %>%
  mutate(
    tss_mid   = (tss_start + tss_end) / 2,
    rel_start = ifelse(V6.x == "+", V10.x - tss_mid, tss_mid - V11.x),
    rel_end   = ifelse(V6.x == "+", V11.x - tss_mid, tss_mid - V10.x)
  )

# subset and fix y consistently
df_plot_sub <- df_plot %>%
  filter(ltr == "LTR2B") %>%
  mutate(V4_trunc = str_trunc(V4, 16)) %>%
  arrange(V8.x, V4) %>% 
  mutate(
    y = factor(paste0(V8.x, " | ", V4),
               levels = unique(paste0(V8.x, " | ", V4)))
  ) 

ggplot(df_plot_sub) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = rel_start, xmax = rel_end,
                ymin = as.numeric(y) - 0.3, ymax = as.numeric(y) + 0.3),
            fill = "steelblue", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -10, xmax = 10,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "red", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_len(nlevels(df_plot_sub$y)),
    labels = paste0(sub(" \\|.*", "", levels(df_plot_sub$y)), " | ",                str_trunc(sub(".*\\| ", "", levels(df_plot_sub$y)), 16)),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Position of LTR relative to TSS (bp)", y = "LTR2B w/ associated transcripts") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))
```
